summary: VirnetX Holding Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to $19,135,717 of common stock under a sales agreement dated October 1, 2026 with Titan Partners Securities LLC as agent. Sales may occur on Nasdaq (symbol VHC) at prevailing prices; the last reported sale price was $10.32 on September 29, 2026. The agent receives a 3% commission. Non-affiliates held 3,585,706 shares, with a public float of $57,407,153 based on $16.01 per share. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; the main risk is dilution overhang.
